description: Resolve a human-readable name to addresses across ENS (Ethereum) and SNS (Solana, Bonfida). For .eth: returns Ethereum address + reverse lookup. For .sol: returns Solana owner wallet + the wallet's other owned .sol domains + favorite domain. Names without a suffix are tried against both registries.

name.description: Name to resolve, e.g. "vitalik.eth", "bonfida.sol", or bare "vitalik" (tried in both registries).

name: ens_sns_resolve
title: Resolve ENS + SNS names to addresses
